title: Great camera full of features
content:
ProCCD harkens users back to the days when digital cams with a CCD sensor were all the rage. But the camera choices don’t actually stop there. Instant film, disposable camera, SLR, there are a couple of dozen options. It can be a little overwhelming at first, all the choices. But the app allows you to sort/manage the camera list so you can move your favorites to the front. 

The dev team provides updates regularly, it’s great to see consistent delivery of new cameras, films, and features. One thing I’d like to see is the ability to bypass the GUI theme and simply use full screen. Some of the cameras have smaller viewfinders so it’s a little tricky to frame a shot. 

The pictures this app creates are really amazing. There are so many ways to create some unique shots and looks, I find myself just scrolling through the many different setups and taking test shots. Part of the fun is narrowing down the styles you prefer. 

I feel like this dev also plays “fair” with the pricing model. There are a few cameras and features that are always free. You can opt to purchase (after trying) some cameras individually for $1.99. Or you can pay to be VIP. It’s $5.99 annually or $15 lifetime. I think both prices are very fair considering all of the content you’re getting. 

Big fan of the app. Great images, lots of fun looks and features, a fair pricing scheme, lots of ways to try things before you buy anything. Constant updates from the developer add to the app’s longevity. If you’re a camera lover and looking for a new way to upgrade your shooting experience I’d say there’s no reason not to download ProCCD!
